```yaml
name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master, dev ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master, dev ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run tests
      run: pytest
```
